description: USE THIS to verify a phone/device IMEI before relying on it — never assume a 15-digit string is valid or guess its check digit. Checks the Luhn check digit (and recognises the 16-digit IMEISV form), and returns the TAC (device-model code). Validates the number only — does NOT check whether the device is real, active, or blocklisted/stolen.

imei.description: The 15-digit IMEI (or 16-digit IMEISV); spaces and dashes are ignored.

name: validate_imei
